title: Partner embed request blocked with HTTP 403

partner_report.symptom: Embedded player does not load on partner site
partner_report.expected_behavior: Player loads successfully inside approved partner page
partner_report.actual_behavior: Embed remains blank and network request fails

console_signals: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 403
likely_root_cause: Embed or playback bootstrap request is being denied due to policy, allowlist, referrer, or authorization mismatch
repro_steps: Reload the page with DevTools open
Verify status code 403 and compare origin/referrer/auth headers
Confirm whether issue reproduces across sessions
recommended_partner_actions: Verify partner origin and referrer are configured correctly
Confirm authorization token is valid and expected for this embed path
Check whether the domain is allowlisted for playback/embed use
Capture response body or header reason for policy denial
